candidate_id_contract.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 pipe-joined ordered field values; candidate_id is homi-candidate: plus the first 20 hexadecimal characters.
candidate_id_contract.normalization: NFKC, trim, and casefold for matching only; observed names and source locators are preserved.
candidate_id_contract.promotion_rule: Candidate IDs are deterministic analysis handles, not canonical IDs; no candidate in this report is promoted.

capability_maturity.M0: Concept/R&D: prototype, laboratory, university, or announced technology; does not prove production readiness or reliability.
capability_maturity.M1: Fabricator: builds frames, tanks, housings, simple assemblies, or standard equipment; does not prove indigenous controls, precision subsystems, or qualified output.
capability_maturity.M2: Integrator: combines modules into a working cell or line; does not prove critical IP ownership or repeatability at scale.
capability_maturity.M3: Builder: designs and manufactures a complete machine platform; does not prove frontier performance parity.
capability_maturity.M4: Qualified builder: accepted in a demanding or regulated production environment with customer, standard, repeat-installation, and traceable-performance evidence.
capability_maturity.M5: Frontier strategic capability: globally scarce capability with validated process window, reliability, sustained production, and service ecosystem; still does not guarantee surge capacity.

manufacturer.meaning: A legal entity linked to an identified physical facility and relevant process or machine family by current evidence.

potential_supplier.meaning: A facility or builder with a plausible process envelope and dependencies, but incomplete product-, route-, customer-, and qualification-specific evidence.

qualified_supplier.meaning: Exact site, machine/process, product or requirement revision, material, customer or regulator, and current acceptance/qualification evidence are linked.

available_capacity.meaning: Current time-windowed good qualified output after commitments, yield, tooling, test, material, labor, maintenance, logistics, and sub-tier deductions.

status_semantics.machine_label_guard: The existence of a machine labelled 5-axis, semiconductor, battery, or robot does not prove simultaneous performance, product qualification, uptime, indigenous subsystem content, or serviceable installed capacity.

Industrial robots, factory automation, metrology and test: robots, drives, PLC/CNC, machine vision, CMM, NDT, environmental and reliability test

conflicts_and_format_signals.signal: HEC utilization and indigenous-content claims use incompatible or incomplete scopes.
conflicts_and_format_signals.resolution: Preserve claim-level provenance and reconcile nameplate, installed, operating, qualified, and current periods before aggregation.

conflicts_and_format_signals.signal: Integrator or builder claims can be mistaken for indigenous arm, reducer, controller, or vacuum-system manufacture.
conflicts_and_format_signals.resolution: Decompose product BOM and retain organization roles separately.

conflicts_and_format_signals.signal: Global CSV/JSON export has minor escaped-apostrophe serialization drift in one memo.
conflicts_and_format_signals.resolution: Review the source text and avoid byte-level merge; do not count the mirror pair twice.

unknowns_conflicts.absence_guard: No facility-level, product-specific qualified supplier or current available-capacity record was promoted from this context slice.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: The original context label points to manus-15, but manus-15 is aerospace and manus-16 is equipment.
ambiguities_escalations.impact: Using manus-15 as equipment would mislabel aerospace evidence and corrupt supplier-to-equipment relations.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Use manus-16 report and retain manus-15 mapping audit.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: Global and India CSV/JSON pairs are mirrored exports.
ambiguities_escalations.impact: Double counting would inflate source support and cluster totals.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Count each logical 12-row set once; retain physical artifact hashes.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: Cluster records blend process physics, builder names, public projects, and analyst estimates.
ambiguities_escalations.impact: A cluster row cannot directly become a facility, machine instance, supplier, or capacity record.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Decompose decision-sensitive claims into facility-level primary evidence.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: Some numeric claims have broad or unstated scope, period, and denominator.
ambiguities_escalations.impact: Precision-looking capacity or utilization can be laundered into available supply.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Require value, unit, scope, period, class, source, and confidence for each numeric property.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: Policy targets and announced projects are interleaved with current capability discussion.
ambiguities_escalations.impact: Scenario may be mistaken for operating capacity or qualified equipment.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Keep SCENARIO/PLANNED edges separate from world-state records until commissioning and acceptance evidence exists.

ambiguities_escalations.issue: Builder and subsystem names are not always linked to legal entity, plant, service territory, or BOM origin.
ambiguities_escalations.escalation: Resolve legal name, site, product family, supplier tier, origin, and service evidence.
